attribution.note: Marcus directly asserts the signing and endorses the comparison to his proposal.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the dated signing claim and approximate similarity without asserting an identical approval system.

contract.note: Reading the comparison as government review before release is ordinary and fair. Marcus does not explicitly claim mandatory approval; voluntary participation materially limits the analogy.

evidence.note: Contemporary reporting confirms the June 2 signing and directs a voluntary framework for federal review of frontier models before release.
The report corroborates the signing and pre-release federal vetting. Voluntary participation and the national-security focus qualify the analogy without defeating the contract's similarity criterion.

reviews.rationale: Both reports establish the June 2 signing and a framework for government checks before advanced models are released. This satisfies the fair similarity reading. The framework is voluntary and focused on national security, so the evidence does not establish mandatory FDA-style approval or coverage of every commercially consequential model.
